signature.one_line: Keyed speaker over swapped backgrounds, zig-zag stacked captions with one gradient key line, illustrated phrase cards every few seconds.
unique_devices: Zig-zag staircase caption stack: 1-2-word lines alternately hug left (x ~21 %) and right (x ~75 %) edges of an x 18-78 % column, 2-4 lines deep, then hard-clear
Key line filled with a vertical gradient that fades to near-white at the baseline (pink, second accent or yellow), Inter 800 among Inter 500 white lines
Background swap inside the opening shot (speaker cut-out keyed onto a glowing rising-chart graphic by frame ~12) so the hook moves before the first cut
Full-screen illustrated phrase cards (~45 % of runtime) whose stacked text IS the spoken line, with not-yet-spoken lines greyed and blurred
signature.why_it_works: The picture changes every few seconds without losing the speaker; cards double as captions, so every claim is both heard and seen, and the gradient key line pins the claim.

hook.first_frame: medium shot of the speaker against a real outdoor wall; within ~12 frames the background is replaced by a glowing second accent rising bar-chart graphic, with the first 2 words centred at ~60 % height in a second accent gradient

structure.what: one contrarian sentence; background swap to a graphic behind the keyed speaker; hook words in big second accent gradient
the viewer's problem, alternating speaker and full-screen phrase cards roughly every 72 frames
turn to the answer, marked by a short flash to a new location and a PiP title card
offer features, each on its own card, location or keyed background
client names over a motion-blurred graphic, then client logo cards above the speaker
reframe of the viewer's pain as the thesis, on a money-themed card
spoken + on-screen CTA with a button pill and chevrons, then a silent logo end card

pacing.notes: cut-rate swings 0-36 cuts/min per 5-second window: bursts in the claim and list sections, one long hold for proof; 50 % J-lead cuts; wall-to-wall voice (96 % speech coverage)

captions.what: zig-zag stacked 1-2-word lines, white Inter 500 + one gradient key line Inter 800
captions.how: band y 52-72 %, column x 18-78 %; 89-100 px white, 100 px key; blur 8->0 px + fade + 2.5 % H slide-up over 5-6 frames, ease-out; whole stack hard-cuts at clause end

captions.what: hook words alone in a big second accent gradient
captions.how: Inter 800 127 px, centred, centre y 60.6 %, same blur/slide entry over 6 frames, hard cut out

background_text.how: two-line title (small + bold) in dark green at y 13-17 % above a centred portrait window on white
rounded light-grey square ~35 % W, top-centre y 2-17 %, black wordmark

motion_graphics.how: lines blur + fade in over ~7 frames with ~1 % H upward drift; inactive lines grey + blurred until spoken; one accent line with a dark 3D extrusion shadow

motion_graphics.what: zoom-blur entry into a speaker shot
motion_graphics.how: radial zoom blur resolving over ~6 frames into the static shot

motion_graphics.what: animated 3D sweep / slow scroll on some cards
motion_graphics.how: slow camera sweep or vertical scroll across the illustrated still for the card's duration

cards_lists.how: flat pastel or illustrated stills (lavender-grey stock person with eye bar, silhouettes on white, accent halftone collage, lavender geometric shapes, thumbnail strip, wallet with currency notes); 2-4 stacked text lines upper third or centre
each feature gets its own card, location or keyed background instead of an on-screen bullet list

silhouettes_cutouts.what: speaker cut-out keyed over graphic backgrounds
silhouettes_cutouts.when: hook (from frame ~12) and the start of the list beat (~37 %)
silhouettes_cutouts.how: full matte of the speaker, background replaced by a glowing rising-chart graphic or a board of sample-content tiles; speaker scale and position unchanged
illustrated silhouettes as card art behind the kinetic text

broll_inserts.what: illustrated / stock stills used as cards
broll_inserts.how: replace the speaker full-screen; voice continues as VO with J-lead cuts

layout.how: speaker clip in a centred portrait window x ~25-77 %, y ~22-74 %, title above

camera.what: locked-off medium / medium-close talking head across ~4 locations
camera.how: no digital punch-ins; framing alternates MS/MCU between locations; new backdrop marks each section

transitions.how: cut to card while the sentence continues
~7-frame shot at a new location before the PiP card, marking the turn
zoom-blur or short soft entry on a few speaker shots

end_card.how: white pill with italic caps in accent and a double down-chevron at y 77-89 % for ~108 frames; then ~55 silent frames of a white logo card

case.line: sentence case as spoken (capital only at sentence start)
case.key: lowercase / as spoken (acronyms and proper nouns keep caps)

grouping.lines_on_screen: 1-4 (a stack grows line by line, then clears)
grouping.sync: line by line: each new 1-2-word line appears on its first spoken word
grouping.break: the whole stack hard-cuts out at the end of the clause / sentence or on a picture cut; the next clause starts a new stack

layout.stack: zig-zag / staircase: lines alternately hug the left edge (x ~18-23 %) and the right edge (x ~68-76 %) of the column, so each line is offset from the one above. Typical 4-line stack: line 1 left-aligned x 21-59 % centre y 54.7 %; line 2 (key) x 23-76 % centre y 59.7 %; line 3 right-aligned x 41-75 % centre y 63 %; line 4 right-aligned ending ~75 % at y ~69 %. Hook-style 3-line stack: x 17-53 % (y 57 %), x 31-69 % (y 61 %), x 19-51 % (y 66 %).
layout.line_pitch_pct_of_H: 4.3-5.0 (baseline to baseline; line-height ~0.85-0.9 of font size, lines nearly touching)
layout.single_line: a lone line / key line is centred horizontally (x centre 50 %, spanning ~23-77 % W), centre y 60-62 %
layout.on_graphic_cards: upper third (y 18-35 %) or centre (y 40-55 %) of the card, same stacking logic, dark or coloured text

line.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, single-storey g, straight-tailed y, flat-topped t with angled cut; the original face is slightly wider than Inter (closer to SF Pro Display)
line.shadow: tight dark drop shadow down-right, ~3px 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.65) at 1080 (estimated)
line.size_spread: lines in one stack are not all the same size: shorter lines solve to ~101-103 px in Inter 500 vs ~89 px for the calibration line - vary white lines between ~90 and ~100 px

key.letterform_evidence: same skeleton as the white lines, much heavier stems; double-storey a and single-storey g
key.color: vertical gradient (top -> bottom). Pink: #E65E79 -> #ED9AAE (mid) -> #F3C7D8, almost white at the baseline. Alternate key colours with the same recipe: blue #83AAE9 -> #CEDBF8, yellow #EFDE72 -> #F2E7A0
key.shadow: tight dark drop shadow down-right, ~3px 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.65) at 1080 (estimated)
key.selection_rule: the 1-2-word phrase that carries the claim (a noun phrase, a negation, or the brand name); one per stack, never more

hook.shadow: tight dark drop shadow down-right, ~3px 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.65) at 1080 (estimated)
hook.use: the first 2 words of the hook only (frames 1-24), alone and centred at y ~60.6 %; source 2-word hook measured ink 4.77 % H, width 53.6 % W - compute the expected ink for the user's words with fit_font.py

animation.entry: per line: blur-in + fade (blur ~8 px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1) sharp after 2-3 frames, while the line slides up ~2.5 % of H (~48 px at 1920) easing out over 5-6 frames (measured centre y 62.1 -> 61.6 -> 60.9 -> 60.4 -> 59.7 % over +0..+4 f; hook 63.2 -> 60.7 % over 6 f)
animation.per_word_or_phrase: per line (1-2 words); lines already on screen do not move
animation.timing: line first visible 0 to +6 frames after the transcript word start (typically +0 to +4 f)
animation.highlight: static: the key line is coloured from its entry; no karaoke sweep
animation.exit: hard cut: the whole stack disappears in one frame at the clause end (next clause appears 1 frame later) or with the picture cut
animation.cards: card text lines blur + fade in over ~7 frames with ~1 % H upward drift; not-yet-active lines on a card can sit greyed and blurred (depth-of-field look) until spoken

captions_spec.notes: Positions, sizes, colours and frame timings measured on video frames; font names are closest matches (unverified); shadow values estimated.

other_text_spec.when: 8 cards, ~45 % of runtime, 36-144 frames each, one every 72-144 frames; first at ~4 %, last (payoff) 80-89 %
other_text_spec.bg: flat or illustrated stills: lavender-grey #D2D2E0 with a greyscale eye-barred stock person; white with black silhouettes; maroon halftone collage; lavender #6563F9 geometric-shape card; beige content-thumbnail strip; teal card with a wallet of currency notes
other_text_spec.text: the spoken phrase as 2-4 stacked lines, same zig-zag stack logic and fonts as captions, upper third (y 18-35 %) or centre (y 40-55 %). Typical: 'Lead words' black #060609 medium (ink 3.36 % H, x 18-74 %), a not-yet-spoken line grey and blurred, 'KEY WORD' black extra-bold (ink 4.84 % H, 53.1 % W, ~94 px), a small right-aligned tail line; soft blurred dark drop shadow ~6 px. Accent lines: solid purple #6361F3 with a dark 3D extrusion shadow (centre y 47 %); yellow-gradient / pink-gradient key lines near the top (y 5-10 %); white line on maroon at top (y ~11 %)

other_text_spec.bg: white #F3F3FC with the speaker clip as a portrait window centred (x ~25-77 %, y ~22-74 %) (estimated)
other_text_spec.text: two-line title: small 'Lead words' + bold 'Headline here' below it, dark green #236721 (measured), stacked left-of-centre at y ~13-17 % (x ~25-70 %)
rounded light-grey square card (~35 % W) with a black serif client wordmark, top-centre at y 2-17 %, above the speaker's head

'CTA line' white medium sans (ink 3.59 % H, 46.2 % W, centre y 60 %, x 29-75 %) + a fully-rounded white pill #F6F5FD (x 28-77 %, y 77.3-84.2 %) with italic extra-bold caps 'CTA' in crimson #B7223A (ink 2.34 % H, x 36-68 %, centre y 80.7 %) and a white double down-chevron below it (y ~86-89 %)
white background, black logo lockup (mark + 2-line wordmark) centred at ~50 % height, ~70 % W

style.look_intent: high-contrast, muted, warm natural daylight with natural skin; graphic cards in pastel beige, lavender, teal and maroon

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected); wall-to-wall voice, heavily compressed (LRA 1.8 LU)
sfx: optional soft whoosh on zoom-blur / soft entries (~17 % of cuts)
no hits on hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.2)
silence under the logo end card

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: a single speaker pitches a service or offer and needs every claim visualised
the user has illustration / stock stills or can generate flat pastel cards
the script is a problem -> answer -> features -> proof -> CTA ad
the user can shoot or matte the speaker for background swaps

avoid_when: the user wants maximum face time / a personal, raw creator feel
no time or assets for ~8 custom cards
long monologue without a list or offer structure
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B40 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B40.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: white lines and the key gradient must stay >= 3:1 on the footage, card text >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}})
- {{TEXT}} caption lines - default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}} key-line gradient top colour - default #E65E79 (gradient tints to near-white at the baseline: #E65E79 -> #ED9AAE -> #F3C7D8)
- {{ACCENT_2}} hook / alternate key gradient - default #83AAE9 (-> #A8C4F4 -> #CEDBF8); a third key colour may follow the same recipe (default yellow #EFDE72 -> #F2E7A0)
- {{SURFACE}} phrase-card background - default lavender-grey #D2D2E0 (card text near-black #060609)
- {{CARD_BG}} CTA pill / PiP-card white - default #F6F5FD; button text default crimson #B7223A
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} key line / hook / button - default Inter 800 (ExtraBold)
- {{FONT_BODY}} caption lines - default Inter 500 (Medium)
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle (not shown on screen in this blueprint; optional on the end card)
- {{LOGO}} - logo lockup for the end card and logo-proof cards

Canvas 1080x1920, 24 fps (23.976). All positions are % of frame.

CAPTIONS
1. Latin script, as spoken; sentence case for {{TEXT}} lines; key lines as spoken (lowercase; acronyms / brand names keep caps).
2. Grouping: split each clause into 1-2-word lines (max 3). Lines STACK: each new line appears under the previous one on its first spoken word, up to 4 lines; at the clause end (or a picture cut) the whole stack hard-cuts out and the next clause starts fresh. At most ONE key line per stack - the 1-2 words that carry the claim.
3. Lines: {{FONT_BODY}}, 89 px (stacked lines may vary 89-101 px), {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke, no box, tight dark drop shadow down-right (~3px 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.65), estimated).
4. Key line: {{FONT_DISPLAY}}, 100 px, vertical gradient top->bottom {{ACCENT}} -> mid tint -> near-white at the baseline. Rotate {{ACCENT_2}} (same recipe) for variety. Same shadow, no stroke.
5. Hook: the first 2 spoken words alone, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 127 px, {{ACCENT_2}} gradient, centred, centre y 60.6 %, on screen for frames 1-24, then hard cut.
6. Layout: column x 18-78 %, band y 52-72 % (torso, below the chin). Zig-zag: alternate lines hug the column's left edge (x ~21 %) and right edge (x ~75 %); typical stack: line 1 left x 21-59 % centre y 54.7 %, line 2 (key) x 23-76 % y 59.7 %, line 3 right-aligned to 75 % y 63 %, line 4 right-aligned y ~69 %. Baseline pitch 4.3-5 % H (line-height 0.85-0.9). A lone line is centred at y 60-62 %.
7. Animation: each line blurs in (8 px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, sharp after 2-3 frames) while sliding up ~2.5 % H (~48 px), ease-out (power3.out) over 5-6 frames; lines already on screen stay still; line appears 0-4 frames after its first word; exit = hard cut of the whole stack; no idle motion, no karaoke.

OTHER TEXT / EDIT DEVICES
8. Opening: matte the speaker and swap the background to a glowing {{ACCENT_2}} rising-chart graphic by frame ~12 of shot 1; first cut at ~4 % of runtime.
9. Phrase cards (~45 % of runtime, 36-144 frames each, one every 72-144 frames on VO beats): full-screen flat/illustrated still on {{SURFACE}} or other pastel tones; the spoken phrase as 2-4 stacked lines (same zig-zag) in the upper third (y 18-35 %) or centre (y 40-55 %): 'Lead words' near-black {{FONT_BODY}}, 'KEY WORD' near-black {{FONT_DISPLAY}} ~94 px; inactive lines grey + blurred until spoken; soft ~6 px dark shadow; lines blur + fade in over ~7 frames with ~1 % H upward drift. Accent variant: one solid {{ACCENT}}-family line with a dark 3D extrusion shadow.
10. Turn marker: a ~7-frame shot at a new location, then a {{CARD_BG}} card with the speaker in a centred portrait window (x 25-77 %, y 22-74 %) under a two-line title ('Lead words' small / 'Headline here' bold) at y 13-17 %, in a dark brand colour.
11. Logo proof: rounded light-grey square (~35 % W) with a client wordmark, top-centre y 2-17 %, above the speaker's head.
12. CTA (last ~11 % of runtime): 'CTA line' in {{TEXT}} {{FONT_BODY}} ~100 px at centre y 60 % + a fully-rounded {{CARD_BG}} pill at x 28-77 %, y 77.3-84.2 % with italic {{FONT_DISPLAY}} caps 'CTA' (ink 2.3 % H) in the brand's dark accent and a white double down-chevron at y 86-89 %, ~108 frames; then ~55 silent frames of {{LOGO}} centred on white at ~70 % W.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, muted, warm, natural skin; pastel cards.
SOUND: voice only, compressed to about -14 LUFS; optional soft whoosh on zoom-blur entries only; silence under the end card.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Inter; if the brand font differs, adjust px until the ink numbers match):
a) Render test frames over a dark area: "They trust" ({{TEXT}}, {{FONT_BODY}} 89 px), "people who" (key gradient, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 100 px), "KEY WORD" (hook, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 127 px).
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.1,0.5,0.9,0.66 --ink "{{TEXT}}:45,{{ACCENT}}:70,{{ACCENT_2}}:60" (tighten --box to one line if lines overlap).
c) Required: "They trust" ink 4.14 % +-0.5 of H and 37.9 % +-2 of W; "people who" 4.45 % +-0.5 and 52.4 % +-2. For the hook word (or any other word) compute the expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<{{FONT_DISPLAY}}>" --word "KEY WORD" at 127 px and compare. Positions within +-1 % of H of the numbers above.
